evidence.title: OpenShaders: Shaders belong on the web
GitHub - openshaders/openshaders: The biggest open-source home for shaders on the web.

name: Explore | OpenShaders
summary: Gallery of all 3,191 usernames claimed before OpenShaders launches, each rendered as its own one-of-one shader.
description: The explore view of OpenShaders lists every claimed name, newest first, with the unique shader generated for that name rendered in place. Switch between immersive and grid views and filter by rarity; each card links to the member's profile.
contains: each name renders a one-of-one shader generated for it
